newsitem.title: USA: Edison San Onofre 3 Calif. nuke at 90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Edison San Onofre 3 Calif. nuke at 90 pct.

text.p: Edison International's 1,080 megawatt (MW) San Onofre 3 nuclear power unit has been reduced to 90 percent power for maintenance, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday in its plant status report.
The unit, in San Clemente, Calif., is operating at reduced power so operators can reduce marine growth in the plant's cooling system, the NRC said.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
The adjacent unit 2, with a generating capacity of 1,070 MW, has been shut down for maintenance and refueling since November 30.
The unit was scheduled to restart around February 8, but the company said last week that this may be delayed by about 10-15 days for additional maintenance.
The units are operated and majority-owned by Edison International's Southern California Edison Co.
